test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The rural households in many of the developing countries __don’t have fully fictional tap water__ connections.

options.text: don’t have fully functional tap water
don’t have fully revisional tap water
don’t have fully devotional tap water
don’t have fully erosional tap water

solution:
The correct answer is:** 'don’t have fully functional tap water'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence is: **'don’t have fully functional tap water'.**
 
• The underlined segment of the given sentence has an error of **'Spelling'.**
 
• The word **'Fictional'** means Imaginary, Fairy, Artificial, Mythical, Fictitious etc.
 
• So, replacing the word **'Fictional'** with **'Functional'** will make the sentence correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 1'.**

**Correct sentence:**__ *The rural households in many of the developing countries **__don’t have fully functional tap water__** connections.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **'don’t have fully revisional tap water'** is not correct here.
 
• **'don’t have fully devotional tap water' **is not correct here.
 
• **'don’t have fully erosional tap water'** is not correct here.
